title: Backyard Legends
description: Adidas's 2026 hero spot, set in streets and side-lots and built on the idea that legends are forged in backyard games. Stars Timothée Chalamet, Lionel Messi, Bad Bunny, Lamine Yamal, Jude Bellingham and Trinity Rodman — six headliners under the 'You Got This' platform. The 90s-coded visual register is the most editorial decision in the spot.

title: Get Access to FIFA World Cup 2026
description: Marriott Bonvoy's 'Get Access' platform — the hospitality side of the 2026 activation, framing matchday access and Marriott Bonvoy Moments hotel stays as the path to the World Cup experience. Co-branded with Visa as payments partner. Marriott is FIFA's Official Hotel Supporter for North America (Tier 3 Regional Supporter), with the activation spanning 104 matches across the three host countries.

title: Let It Pour
description: Budweiser's 2026 platform film with Erling Haaland and Jürgen Klopp, built on the 'letting it all out' frame — pressure and catharsis as the emotional center, cinematic moments scaled to fan reactions worldwide. The longer hero in Bud's 2026 tournament work.

title: The Most Epic Watch Party
description: Lay's reactivates 'No Lay's, No Game' as its tournament platform — a fictional WhatsApp watch party where Messi, Beckham, Henry, Putellas and Steve Carell share the same group chat. The Carell casting is the spot's editorial wink.

title: Power Your Fate
description: Powerade's 'Power Your Fate' platform with Lamine Yamal and Rodrygo Goes — the brand positioned as the fuel between preparation and the decisive moment. Cinematic readiness-rituals frame, distributed across global TV, digital and creator content.

title: The Superior Match
description: Michelob Ultra's 2026 platform under 'Superior is Worth Playing For', launched May 12 with the hotel-lobby pitch film: Pulisic, Sergiño Dest and Antonee Robinson go up against Messi, Lautaro Martínez and Nicolás Paz, with Guillermo Ochoa in goal, a Ronaldo Nazário cameo, Alex Morgan with the late assist, and Billy Bob Thornton as the lobby guest waiting on his beer. Builds on the December 2025 Superior Player of the Match trophy reveal under the same Anheuser-Busch Official Beer Sponsor activation.

title: Pepsi Football Nation
description: Pepsi's 'Football Nation' global platform with David Beckham handing the playbook to fans — fan interactions, playful rivalry, memes and real-time reactions over match action. Featured cast also includes Vinícius Jr., Mohamed Salah, Florian Wirtz, Lauren James and Alexia Putellas. The campaign's YouTube canonical (on Pepsi Global) carries the sub-title 'The Home of Football Banter & Rivalry.' Agency: BigTime Creative Shop.

title: Celebration ft. David Beckham
description: Stella Artois's 'For Moments Worth More' platform with David Beckham — shared viewing occasions, hospitality and the social side of the tournament, rather than match action itself. A quieter register than the Bud line in the same AB InBev portfolio.

title: 50 Days to Go
description: Diageo's 50-days-to-go countdown moment ahead of the June 11 opener — a portfolio-wide brand activation tying multiple Diageo labels to the tournament.

title: The Coooors Call
description: Coors Light's 'Coooors Call' bit — announcer Andrés Cantor stretching the elongated 'GOOOOAL' shout into the brand name. A :30 spot, with a UGC arm inviting fans to submit their own Coooors Call (featuring Cantor's son in the social cut). Beer-money prize.

title: Do You Believe? Everything Can Happen on Home Soil
description: FOX Sports's US broadcaster platform for 2026, anchored on the 'home soil' narrative — the first US-hosted men's tournament since 1994. Built for the broader American audience the network needs to recruit beyond core football fans.

title: Copa do Mundo Brahma
description: Brahma's 2026 platform film. AB InBev's flagship Brazilian beer running its own local narrative alongside Bud's global Haaland/Klopp work — more national-team coded, more Carnival-adjacent in visual register.

title: When Fans Go Wild
description: Motorola's 2026 global tournament film, framed around fan reactions and device-as-camera storytelling. The brand's headline 2026 activation, distinct from regional cutdown variants that surface on local channels.

title: The Big Drop
description: Budweiser's bottle-design platform for 2026 — a separate creative track from the main 'Let It Pour' brand spot, focused on Bud's collectible packaging and the design system across the tournament cycle. Same global activation umbrella as Let It Pour but a distinct creative concept, not a cutdown.

title: JUMP (FIFA World Cup 2026 Anthem)
description: Coca-Cola's official 2026 anthem — an updated cover of Van Halen's 'Jump' performed by J Balvin, Amber Mark, Steve Vai and Travis Barker. Released via Real Thing Records in partnership with Capitol Records. The standalone music drop after a teased preview in January's 'Bubbling Up' film.

title: Uncanned Emotions
description: The second film in Coca-Cola's 'All the Feels' trilogy (after January's 'Bubbling Up', before a third spot timed to kickoff). Focuses on raw, unfiltered fan reactions — spontaneous celebrations, disappointments, shared viewing experiences. Coke has been a FIFA stadium partner since 1950.

title: Ultimate Access
description: Verizon's 'Ultimate Access' platform, launched September 2025 as the brand's first World Cup activation under Official Telecommunications Sponsor status. Beckham works his way from the nosebleeds down to the pitch, anchored on the 'no one gets you closer' line. Rolled out across Sept–Dec 2025 in four waves, each released across IG + TikTok with new talent and creative — Tim Howard, Chucky Lozano, the Thompson sisters, plus the 'Golden Ticket' sweepstakes rewarding 20 customer fans with personal video calls from the all-star roster.

title: For You, the Fans
description: Mastercard's continuation of its long-running Messi partnership. La Colección Diez de Diez: ten limited-edition jerseys designed with creative director Guillermo Andrade, each inspired by a chapter of Messi's career. A jersey-swap concept extended into a collectible.

title: The world's gone football
description: Owen Trevor Black's Rattling Stick film for Lenovo, framing the brand's AI infrastructure as the engine behind the most technologically advanced World Cup in history. Shot in a Bucharest studio with AI-generated and AI-enhanced vignettes — itself a statement about where the work is going.

title: The Next Legend
description: Kia's 2026 hero, built around the brand's 'movement that inspires' positioning. Connects football's generational legend-making to Kia's sponsorship platform — a global, multi-generational fan story rather than a celebrity-first read.

title: Home Field Advantage
description: Jim Beam × U.S. Soccer co-branded launch. 'Home advantage' as the emotional center — shared viewing moments and matchday rituals at home and in local bars, not stadium reverence. Distributed across digital, social, and on-trade promotions.

title: U.S. Soccer Anthem
description: Boston Beer Co's 'Drink like a Believer' platform for Truly. The campaign launches a nationwide search to rename one American town 'Believe, USA', with USMNT's Weston McKennie as the anchor. Brand plans a full town takeover of the winning community ahead of kickoff.

title: Bubbling Up
description: The opener of Coca-Cola's 'All the Feels' trilogy, released January 27, 2026 — three months before 'Uncanned Emotions' and four months before the JUMP anthem dropped as a standalone track. A fan's pre-tournament anticipation spills into everyday moments (the elevator scene as the central creative metaphor), with a sneak preview of the JUMP anthem before its full release. The platform-launch film for Coke's broader 2026 activation.

title: Everyone Wants a Piece
description: Lego's tournament play stacks Messi, Ronaldo, Mbappé and Vinícius Jr. into brick-built worlds where football fandom and creative play are the same posture. System1 rates it 4.9 stars — the highest of any 2026 World Cup spot they've tested. The YouTube canonical lives on Lego's own channel in Short format; the wider social distribution (6 IG cuts, 6 TT posts) is where the campaign's reach is built.

title: Trust What's Inside
description: Gatorade's 'Trust What's Inside' platform for 2026 — performance and athlete-prep framing. PepsiCo's sports-nutrition arm running parallel to Pepsi's own banter-coded 'Football Nation' platform. System1 rates it 3.0 stars.

title: Made to Be Raised
description: Diageo's Don Julio platform film, directed by Leigh Powis with Thierry Henry arriving at a post-final celebration. Accompanies the new Tequila Don Julio 1942 World Cup 2026 Edition bottle. A second Don Julio film — 'La Otra Copa' (dir. Stillz, with Roberto Carlos + Henry) — runs alongside as the platform's second piece this cycle. System1 rated 'La Otra Copa' at 3.2 stars.

title: For Fans Everywhere
description: Marriott Bonvoy's social-first 2026 platform, anchored on broadcaster Kate Scott and the 'For Fans Everywhere' positioning. Marriott is FIFA's Official Hotel Supporter for North America (Tier 3 Regional Supporter), with the activation spanning 104 matches across the three host countries plus the Marriott Bonvoy Moments hospitality drops. The campaign is published across IG and TikTok with no YouTube canonical — a striking social-first distribution choice for a hospitality brand at this scale.

title: Some Dreams Start on A Simple Pitch
description: Hisense's 2026 hero spot under its 'Beyond Glory' platform — a generational story positioning football as something that fades from life but never truly leaves. Marks the brand's third consecutive FIFA tournament partnership (eight years across the cycle) and the first hero film from Hisense for the 2026 cycle after a string of regional cutdowns, event content and creator collabs were filtered out during the Hero-focus cleanup.

title: From Farm to Field
description: Lay's second tournament chapter, distinct from the 'No Lay's, No Game' watch-party platform — a heritage/origin film tracing the brand's potato fields to the world's biggest stadium. Builds on Lay's positioning as a long-standing FIFA partner with a multi-platform 2026 cycle (watch-party comedy + brand-origin storytelling running in parallel).
